turns.userMessage:
Build a stepped pyramid: square base about 12x12 studs, at least 5 tiers, each tier inset by one stud on every side, in a single sand-colored scheme. Center the tiers so nothing overhangs. 60-140 parts.
Constraints: footprint must fit within 16x16 studs; height at least 120 LDU (5 bricks); use at least 50 parts.
